description: Get All Warehouses. Part of the Warehouse APIs in Giddh. Requires Auth-Key or Session-Id.

q.description: Search text (case sensitivity depends on the endpoint). Optional.

count.description: Page size (number of items returned). Default: 20. Optional.

branchUniqueName.description: Branch uniqueName; omit for default company branch behaviour. Optional.

includeArchived.description: Include archived query parameter. Default: true. Optional.

refresh.description: When true, bypass cache and recompute. Default: false. Optional.
